summary: Castaway Forecasting is a Sydney forecasting and modelling SaaS (founded 2009) selling monthly subscription plans to SMEs and their advisors, with a cloud version released in 2024. Liz Veal joined as Finance Manager in January 2026 after five years running accounts and finance at Qnary, and Siobhan McCann is Financial Accountant.

sources.title: Castaway forecasting takes to the cloud
Discover the Power of Business Forecasting and Modelling

claims.text: Castaway Forecasting's LinkedIn page says it is headquartered in Sydney, NSW, founded 2009, with presence in Canada.
claims.quote: Headquartered in Sydney, New South Wales, Australia, with presence in Canada.

claims.text: Liz Veal's LinkedIn profile lists her as Finance Manager at Castaway Forecasting (current) since January 2026.
Before Castaway, Liz Veal was Accounts and Finance Manager at Qnary from August 2020 to December 2025.
Castaway released a cloud version of its forecasting and modelling software in May 2024, adding collaboration, presentation and integration options.
claims.quote: Australian developer Castaway has released a cloud version of its established forecasting and modelling software

claims.text: Castaway's cloud plans are billed monthly, starting at AUD$150 a month for Plan3.
Castaway integrates directly with Xero and QuickBooks, plus Excel and Google Sheets.
claims.quote: Castaway integrates directly with leading accounting platforms. Xero – Quickbooks – Excel – Google Sheets.

claims.text: A partner at PKF and other accountants praise Castaway; one adviser calls it an essential tool for advisory firms.
claims.quote: Castaway is an essential tool for all advisory firms.

claims.text: Siobhan McCann is Financial Accountant at Castaway Forecasting, current since March 2025.
Castaway's homepage promises customers modelling of any business scenario in a few clicks.
claims.quote: Unmatched modelling in minutes to move your business forward

hooks.text: Liz is about 10 months into the role after leaving a long Finance Manager tenure elsewhere; a good moment to review close tooling.
Monthly subscription plans mean recurring receipts to reconcile to the ledger.
A forecasting vendor selling 'modelling in minutes' will appreciate a faster close.

risks.text: Small company (about 11 staff per LinkedIn), so deal size is limited.
Castaway sells to accountants and could be a channel partner rather than only a customer; no competing reconciliation product found.

gaps: Billing and payment stack (Stripe, Chargebee, GoCardless) appears only in a third-party tech profile and could not be verified, so not used.
No posts by Liz Veal, podcast or Facebook content found.
Job ads for finance roles not found.
